newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cyclone in Indian Ocean packing winds to 150 km/hr.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone in Indian Ocean packing winds to 150 km/hr.

text.p: A category two cyclone with wind gusts up to 150 km an hour near the centre was estimated to be 400 km west southwest of the Cocos Islands in the Indian Ocean at 0400 GMT, the Australian Bureau of Meteorology said on Tuesday.
Cyclone Rhonda is expected to track south of the islands and should not cause gales in the area in the next 24 hours.
However gales may develop in 48 hours, the bureau said.
The cyclone was moving east southeast at 10 km an hour, the bureau said.
A category two cyclone carries winds of 125 to 169 km an hour.
Independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday the cyclone would threaten shipping in the southeast Indian Ocean during the next two to three days.
